stressInputGenerator:
import random
import sys

rng = random.Random(20260926)
n = 50000
w = [rng.randint(1, 1000) for _ in range(n)]
labels = list(range(1, n + 1))
rng.shuffle(labels)
edges = []
for i in range(1, n):
    if rng.random() < 0.3:
        p = i - 1
    else:
        p = rng.randint(0, i - 1)
    a, b = labels[i], labels[p]
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        a, b = b, a
    edges.append((a, b))
rng.shuffle(edges)
out = [str(n), ' '.join(map(str, w))]
for a, b in edges:
    out.append(f'{a} {b}')
sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(out) + '\n')
